num_vessels: <int> Number of vessels to be served at the terminal.
num_berths: <int> Number of discrete berths available at the terminal.
total_qc: <int> Total number of quay cranes available across the terminal at each time step.
num_big_profiles: <int> Number of QC profiles to generate for large vessels.
num_small_profiles: <int> Number of QC profiles to generate for small vessels.
time_horizon_hours: <int> Length of the planning horizon in hours.
num_shifts_per_step: <int> Total number of working shifts spanning the planning horizon.
time_steps_per_shift: <int> Number of equal-length time steps within each working shift.
total_time_steps: <int> Total number of time steps in the planning horizon.
c1: <int> Unit cost penalty for deviating from a vessel's least-cost berthing position.
c2: <int> Unit cost penalty for deviating from a vessel's expected arrival time.

vessels.a: <int> Earliest feasible time step at which the vessel can begin service.
vessels.b: <int> Latest feasible time step at which the vessel can begin service.
vessels.k_bar: <int> Least-cost berth index for the vessel, closest to its container yard block.
vessels.t_bar: <int> Expected arrival time step agreed upon between the carrier and terminal.
vessels.duration_hours: <int> Expected total handling duration of the vessel in hours.

berths.a_k: <int> First time step at which the berth is available for service.
berths.b_k: <int> Last time step at which the berth is available for service.

big.min_qc: <int> Minimum number of quay cranes per shift in a large-vessel profile.
big.max_qc: <int> Maximum number of quay cranes per shift in a large-vessel profile.
big.min_handling_shifts: <int> Minimum handling duration in shifts for a large-vessel profile.
big.max_handling_shifts: <int> Maximum handling duration in shifts for a large-vessel profile.

small.min_qc: <int> Minimum number of quay cranes per shift in a small-vessel profile.
small.max_qc: <int> Maximum number of quay cranes per shift in a small-vessel profile.
small.min_handling_shifts: <int> Minimum handling duration in shifts for a small-vessel profile.
small.max_handling_shifts: <int> Maximum handling duration in shifts for a small-vessel profile.
